title: Credit Risk Analyst
summary: Credit risk analysts decide whether a borrower can repay, by studying financial statements, bank statements and credit bureau reports, and then write a credit note with a recommendation. They sit in the credit or risk team of a bank, NBFC (non-bank lender) or bank back office and also watch existing loans for early signs of stress.
dailyDuties: Spread borrower financials and calculate key ratios
Review CIBIL and other bureau reports for repayment history
Write credit appraisal memos with a rating and recommendation
Discuss proposals with relationship managers and the credit committee
Track overdue, SMA and early warning accounts in the portfolio
Check proposals against credit policy and RBI norms

skills.expectation: Appraise loan proposals and write credit appraisal memos with a recommendation
Spread financials and analyse ratios, cash flow and debt service cover
Read CIBIL and other bureau reports to judge repayment track record
Track delinquency, SMA and early warning signals on the loan book
Apply RBI asset classification and prudential lending norms
Build spreading templates and portfolio trackers in Excel
Write clear credit notes and present cases to the credit committee
Work with PD, LGD, scorecard or ECL models
Query loan and bureau data with SQL
Analyse portfolio data with Python or SAS
Know lending products across retail, SME or corporate banking
Work with relationship managers, collections and policy teams
